name: stripe-cli-context-scoped-outbound-82e6
instr:
Stripe CLI cannot isolate outbound destination policy per invocation without global mutable state. Implement a context-carried policy covering commands, transports, downloads, authentication, and telemetry before contact or credential disclosure. Without a configured policy, preserve unrestricted behavior and existing response, redirect, cancellation, filesystem, socket, and error semantics.

`Policy` in `github.com/stripe/stripe-cli/pkg/networkpolicy` must deterministically decide final schemes, hosts, ports, and dial classes before contact, including every HTTP redirect. Enforce it for Stripe and sandbox clients through `SetDestinationPolicy`, WebSocket `Config.DestinationPolicy`, plugin `FetchRemoteResourceWithPolicy`, agent-skill `FetchIndexWithPolicy`, `CheckWithPolicy`, and `InstallWithPolicy`, login `RequestDeviceCodeWithPolicy` and `RevokeTokenWithPolicy`, and config `OutboundPolicy`.

Apply it to sandbox challenge and provisioning requests after sandbox-specific base URL normalization and before proof-workflow network effects. Allowed HTTP operations must preserve transports, response bodies and ownership, request mutation, credentials, proxies, Unix sockets, and established redirect protections. Enforce plugin metadata and binary destinations, including redirects, before creating or replacing files. Concurrent work must respect cancellation. Each refusal must be a non-transient `ViolationError` retaining its rule, destination, and network classification, unobscured
